whatsNew.title: What's Different in 2026–27
content: School starts August 10 in 2026–27, one day earlier on the calendar than the August 11 start in 2025–26.
Thanksgiving Break remains a full Monday-through-Friday week, moving from November 24–28 in 2025 to November 23–27 in 2026.
Winter Break runs December 21–January 4, compared with December 22–January 2 in 2025–26. Classes resume January 5 in both school years.
Spring Recess moves one calendar day earlier, from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 29–April 2 in 2026–27.
The school year ends May 26, compared with May 28 in 2025–26.

calendarFaqs.q: When does San Diego Unified start and end school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027.
Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, 2026; Winter Break is December 21, 2026–January 4, 2027; and Spring Recess is March 29–April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families find SDUSD minimum days?
calendarFaqs.a: The districtwide academic calendar does not list every school-specific minimum day. Check the individual school's calendar and bell schedule before planning pickup, transportation, or childcare.

calendarFaqs.q: Do charter schools follow the SDUSD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not necessarily. Independent charter schools may set their own calendars, so families should confirm dates directly with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloadable calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if SDUSD revises its calendar. Check the official district calendar page for later changes.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, against the official SDUSD academic calendars page and the final 2026–27 academic calendar PDF adopted June 24, 2025.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF marks August 10 as the first day, May 26 as the last day, and lists 180 instructional days.
Holiday and non-instructional labels follow the official H and NI markings. February 12 is described as a district holiday because the PDF does not provide a holiday name.
Return dates are the next instructional days shown after Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Recess.
Individual school minimum days, bell schedules, conferences, and campus events are outside the scope of the districtwide PDF and this calendar file.
